1 lb stewing beef (it's beef cut in chunks) 2-3 Yukon gold potatoes 1 large carrot 1 sweet yellow onion salt, pepper, cloves, onion powder squirt of ketchup squirt of maple syrup squirt of aged chipotle sauce squirt of sweet chilli sauce couple squirts of malt vinegar cup of iced tea few cups of water brown sugar

all the sauces and liquid I used is just what I had lying around so u can use whatever u want really, the thing that makes it a definite Irish stew is the yellow potatoes, beef carrot and onions.

basically just throw salt in the pan and then sear the beef chunks, throw in some onion powder and malt vinegar at the appropriate time

then throw those in a pot with chopped carrots, then caramelize the onions, microwave the potatoes for a few minutes and chip up then throw onions potatoes into pan with onions, then sautée a bit, then throw it all in the pit with the beef and carrots.

fill the pot with water up to just barely showing the surface of the mixture and then start throwing in spices and sauces/ iced tea/ beer/ketchup/another squirt of malt vinegar ---whatever uvwantcto use

the pan should be on medium heat, at first for browning and the pot to the right should be low-medium(small heating plate) once u have everything in the pot , then move the pot over to the medium heat(large heating plate) and the water should be just at a bubbling simmer

leave this alone for about 1.5 hours with the lid on except come to check on it every half hour just to rotate the mixture or add more sauce liquid

with 30 minutes left turn the heat down to below simmer but still about medium/low (you don't want it bubbling just below bubbling

did I mention keep the lid on
to test if the meat is tender take a chuck out and see if u can slice it with a spoon, if the spoon slices throug easily then it's ready
